items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: If you got into a ten dollar gig, man, you must have known Paul Whiteman! Or somebody, you know. Benny Goodman, or somebody, you know. Which did not happen. You didn't know those people.

ctx.x: Sure, yeah, and -- I've got to think of this man's name. Had the band. He had a band like Paul Whiteman, that type of band, and he was in Florida, and --
